impact: The largest cybersecurity deal on record consolidates the sector and could pressure rivals like Palo Alto and Fortinet; no direct effect on Clement's holdings.
summary: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock deal valuing it at about $43.9 billion, announced Nov 23 with its fiscal Q3 results. Each Zscaler share converts into 1.135 CrowdStrike shares. Zscaler may owe a $1.4 billion termination fee in some cases. CrowdStrike says the deal adds network security, expands its addressable market by more than $185 billion and gives a combined business with more than $10 billion in annual recurring revenue.
title: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in $43.9B all-stock deal
